title: Central Precocious Puberty: Hypothalamic Hamartoma, GnRH Testing and Leuprolide
subject: ss-paediatric-endocrinology
module: Precocious and Delayed Puberty, Hypogonadism and Gynecomastia

steps.say: Appearance of secondary sexual characteristics before strict chronological milestones mandates systematic evaluation.
steps.tx: Define premature maturation limits by checking **Chronological age cutoffs for precocious puberty** against physical findings. Precocious puberty is defined as the onset of secondary sexual characteristics before 8 years of age in girls (breast development, thelarche) and before 9 years of age in boys (testicular volume >= 4 mL).

vis.caption: Carpal and epiphyseal ossification landmarks for wrist bone age assessment.

steps.say: Premature reactivation of the central neuroendocrine axis coordinates harmonious pubertal sequence development.
steps.tx: Distinguish central drivers from peripheral sex steroid excess through **Central vs peripheral pathophysiology** evaluation. Central precocious puberty (CPP) is gonadotropin-dependent, caused by premature maturation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal (HPG) axis, maintaining normal pubertal sequence and concordant testicular enlargement in boys. Peripheral precocious puberty occurs independently of gonadotropin secretion.

nodes.label: Anterior Pituitary LH and FSH Release

steps.say: Precocious puberty in young boys carries high probability of underlying structural intracranial pathology.
steps.tx: Evaluate sex-stratified neuroimaging requirements by analyzing **Sex difference in underlying pathology** across pediatric cohorts. Over 80-90% of CPP cases in girls are idiopathic, whereas in boys > 50% are pathological, secondary to CNS lesions (hypothalamic hamartoma, astrocytoma, hydrocephalus, germinoma) mandating routine brain magnetic resonance imaging.

vis.title: CPP Etiology Stratified by Biological Sex
rows: Contrast brain MRI mandatory in all boys

steps.say: Non neoplastic congenital heterotopias generate autonomous gonadotropin pulses alongside characteristic laughing spells.
steps.tx: Identify structural hypothalamic lesions by evaluating **Hypothalamic hamartoma and gelastic seizures** during clinical consultation. Hypothalamic hamartomas are non-neoplastic congenital heterotopias composed of GnRH-secreting neurons, presenting with CPP and pathognomonic refractory gelastic (laughing) seizures originating from the tuber cinereum. Surgical resection or laser ablation is considered for medically intractable epilepsy.

vis.alt: Illustration of pituitary gonadotropin-releasing hormone receptor signaling showing initial receptor activation followed by down-regulation and desensitisation.
vis.caption: Mechanism of GnRH receptor down-regulation by continuous depot GnRH agonists.

steps.say: Dynamic stimulation with gonadotropin releasing hormone confirms pubertal awakening of the pituitary gland.
steps.tx: Confirm central axis activation by establishing **GnRH / Leuprolide stimulation test diagnostic peak** thresholds. Diagnosis is confirmed by GnRH stimulation test: a peak LH > 5.0 IU/L (or stimulated LH-to-FSH ratio > 0.66) indicates pubertal activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary axis. Basal LH > 0.3-0.5 IU/L also strongly supports central puberty.

steps.say: Continuous pituitary receptor occupancy with long acting agonists halts downstream gonadotropin secretion.
steps.tx: Suppress central axis maturation by implementing **Depot GnRH analog therapy protocol** using long-acting formulations. First-line therapy is depot GnRH agonist (leuprolide acetate 7.5-11.25 mg IM monthly, or 30 mg every 3 months) to continuously saturate and desensitize pituitary GnRH receptors, halting LH/FSH secretion.

vis.title: Depot GnRH Agonist Therapeutic Regimens
rows: Sustained receptor saturation and LH suppression

steps.say: Arresting skeletal age advancement prevents premature epiphyseal closure and maximizes ultimate adult height.
steps.tx: Assess therapeutic efficacy and duration through **Treatment monitoring and adult height preservation** auxological tracking. Therapy halts bone age progression and prevents premature epiphyseal fusion, preserving final adult height; treatment is continued until chronological age 11 years in girls and 12 years in boys.

left.title: Discontinuation in Girls
points: Stop therapy at chronological age 11 years

right.title: Discontinuation in Boys
points: Stop therapy at chronological age 12 years

steps.say: Monogenic familial forms result from loss of imprinted central inhibitory tone across the hypothalamus.
steps.tx: Investigate genetic etiologies in familial clustering by analyzing **MKRN3 and DLK1 genetic mutations** on genomic testing. Familial central precocious puberty is most frequently caused by paternally inherited inactivating mutations in makorin ring finger protein 3 (MKRN3 on 15q11.2) or delta-like 1 (DLK1 on 14q32.2).
